correctness.rationale: Every normalized nontrivial Kubo–Ando scalar mean is strictly internal and monotone under the given hypotheses, so min/max monotone and finite-period mixing forces consensus. On log weights, translation-equivariant centered dynamics has Jacobian B=lambda I+(1−lambda) cyclic shift and quadratic analytic remainder; its nonconstant Fourier spectral norm is rho<1. Variation of constants upgrades an initial (rho+eta) bound to C rho^k, with scalar drift O(rho^{2k}). Projection of a small perturbation into the leading Fourier mode has nonvanishing renormalized limit, proving sharpness. At degenerate m2/lambda=.5 the quadratic centered recurrence gives supergeometric decay. Independent mean linearization and Fourier eigenvalue checks verified representative m=3,5,8 cases.
